card.name: The word of after a percentage
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after a percent figure or count, such as "70 percent of" or "8% (52/1889) of". It also fires weakly on other small words inside number and comparison phrases.

modes.label: Of after a percent
modes.description: "of" directly follows a percentage or a count in parentheses, before a group of people or patients.
modes.example: 70 percent<< of>> individuals in North America affected by arthritis are

modes.label: Number-comparison wording
modes.description: Words in ranges and ordering phrases that follow numbers, such as "greater than" or "from greatest".
modes.example: 25 kg 7 Greater than 25 kg to 30 kg 8.5 Greater<< than>> 30 kg to 40

card.plain: It marks the little word "of" that comes after a percentage, just before the group the percentage describes.
